light.notes: Bright, indirect light grows the big split leaves. Direct midday sun through glass scorches them; in too little light new leaves come small and without holes.

water.notes: Water thoroughly when the top 5cm of compost is dry, then let the pot drain.

soil.notes: Chunky, free-draining mix: potting compost with bark and perlite.

toxicity.notes: Insoluble calcium oxalate crystals in the leaves and stems. Chewing causes mouth pain, drooling and vomiting.

guides.feeding: Balanced liquid feed every 2–4 weeks from spring to late summer. None in winter.

guides.propagation: Stem cuttings with at least one node and ideally an aerial root, rooted in water or damp compost.
